result.reason: The clause improves the cap to a mutual 12-month paid-or-payable formulation and adds several required carve-outs, but it does not reach the preferred position: it lacks the USD 1 million floor and express carve-outs for data protection/security, indemnification, and infringement of the other party’s IP. The unidentified Section 8 cross-reference cannot establish an indemnification carve-out from the supplied text, and the margin comment cannot cure that omission. It also disapplies all Section 9 limitations—including the consequential-damages exclusion—for the listed matters, which is broader than merely making those liabilities uncapped, and handles payment obligations less precisely than stating that they are not damages subject to the cap.
